ejm-cli.name: shell
ejm-cli.reason: The native preview's shell calls use the public coding crate. CLI launch grants control permission to run them.

ejm-cli.name: read_file
ejm-cli.reason: ejm-cli gets its native file tools from ejm-harness-coding. The README says only that native file tools are read only until write is granted.

ejm-cli.name: list_files
ejm-cli.reason: Same crate, same reason as read_file.

ejm-cli.name: search
ejm-cli.reason: Same crate, same reason as read_file.

ejm-cli.name: patch_file
ejm-cli.reason: Same crate. This is the write tool the demo blocks until write is granted.

ejm-cli.name: /new
ejm-cli.reason: Listed in the slash command table of the CLI reference. The README links the reference and names only /help.

ejm-cli.name: /sessions
ejm-cli.reason: Same table in the CLI reference.

ejm-cli.name: /stop
ejm-cli.reason: Same table in the CLI reference.

ejm-cli.name: /quit
ejm-cli.reason: Same table in the CLI reference.

ejm-cli.name: /resume
ejm-cli.reason: Same table in the CLI reference. The demo answers that it is not part of the demo.

ejm-cli.name: /queue
ejm-cli.reason: Same table in the CLI reference. The demo answers that it is not part of the demo.

ejm-cli.name: /steer
ejm-cli.reason: Same table in the CLI reference. The demo answers that it is not part of the demo.

ejm-cli.name: Alt+Enter
ejm-cli.reason: Key table in the CLI reference: inserts a newline.

ejm-cli.name: Ctrl+J
ejm-cli.reason: Key table in the CLI reference: the newline fallback.

ejm-cli.name: PageUp
ejm-cli.reason: Key table in the CLI reference: scrolls the transcript.

ejm-cli.name: PageDown
ejm-cli.reason: Key table in the CLI reference: scrolls the transcript.

ejm-cli.name: --plain
ejm-cli.reason: Documented in the CLI reference as ASCII symbols and borders. It is separate from --no-color and NO_COLOR, which the demo's single Plain switch stands in for together.

ejm-cli.name: NO_COLOR
ejm-cli.reason: Documented in the CLI reference as selecting a monochrome TUI.

ejm-ide.name: workbench_open_file
ejm-ide.reason: The native preview opens a file through the public tool named in the agent tools table.

ejm-ide.name: workbench_search_code
ejm-ide.reason: The tool table in the agent tools reference lists it. The README does not list the agent's tools.

ejm-ide.name: workbench_read_file
ejm-ide.reason: Same table in the agent tools reference.

ejm-ide.name: workbench_write_file
ejm-ide.reason: Same table. It proposes an exact file edit, which the demo shows as a diff to accept or reject.
